idea-plugin.name: UMD CS Submit Client
idea-plugin.description:
Import and submit University of Maryland computer science course projects from JetBrains IDEs.

Supports the current browser/CAS verification workflow used by the UMD CS Submit Server and project ZIP importing for course starter projects.

This is an independent open-source project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the University of Maryland.

Based on the original UMD CS Project Integration project by Atheesh Thirumalairajan and modernized by Taha Cheji.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.3.0
First Marketplace-ready release of the maintained fork.
• Supports IntelliJ Platform 2026.2 / build 262.
• Supports UMD CAS/browser verification submission.
• Uses the JDK HTTP client instead of the legacy Apache HttpClient integration.
• Moves maintained code to the com.tahacheji.cssubmitclient namespace.
• Adds Marketplace-ready branding, privacy documentation, verification, signing, and publishing configuration.
